subject: Seneca <> Encord
text:
hi [NAME],

Following Series A and the Aspen deployment - thought it was a good time to
reach out.

We work with teams like Zipline, Skydio, Axon, and Zeitview on the data
infra behind their CV models for exactly the same kind of thermal + video
pipelines Seneca is building.

As you scale deployments beyond Aspen, training data quality and iteration
speed tend to become the bottleneck. Would love to show you what we've
built for teams in similar positions.

20min later this week?

text:
